title: Schilfhorst A
description: Gefächerter Uferhorst mit 31 schlanken Halmen, überhängenden Blattspreiten, fünf braunen Samenständen sowie einzelnen gebrochenen und trockenen Halmen.

review.notes: Round 1. Good: 1.83 m (matches the figure), dense base, a mix of upright culms and drooping leaves, dry leaves mixed in. Defects: (1) the seed heads are rows of separate brown oval beads on spokes, which read as allium/cartoon pods rather than a reed panicle; build soft, feathery panicles (Phragmites) or dense cattail spikes, slightly bent by their weight. (2) Many culms are bare straight sticks of identical thickness rising above the foliage; add nodes and leaf sheaths along the culms and vary their height and lean. (3) Color: dark teal-green leaves, seed heads uniform mid-brown; shift the leaves toward olive and give the heads a warmer straw-brown with a lighter tip. (4) The base has no wet soil or mud collar, even though this asset is meant for the shore.
